concurrency_and_state: Static singleton Char.myChar and Char.myPet (Char.cs:747-749, 1497-1521): clearMyChar() nulls myChar only, leaving myPet, static flags (ischangingMap, isLockKey, isLoadingMap, isManualFocus, fallAttack), and static vItemTime unreset across account/character switches.

Static mount textures (imgMount_*, eyeTraiDat, eyeNamek) cached in Char static fields and lazily reloaded in checkLoadMount() during paintMount1/paintMount2 when mGraphics.zoomLevel changes or imgMount_NM.texture == null (Char.cs:409-456).

Char.checkHideCharName() (Char.cs:3106-3143) iterates GameScr.vCharInMap and GameScr.vNpc with empty try/catch blocks to mask out-of-range/concurrent collection mutations while reading shared static vectors.
Char.taskAction() mixes myCharz() (Char.cs:1344, 1370) and direct static field myChar (Char.cs:1428), risking NullReferenceException if myChar has not been lazily initialized.
Char.update() modifies local cHP/cMP/cStamina optimistically (buff ticks L2404-2446, charge L2982-2983, skill cost L5192-5210) asynchronously from server state updates.
cross_module_questions: Does the Java server validate skill cooldowns, MP, and HP thresholds (e.g. skill 9 self-destruct cHP > cHPFull/10) server-side, or can client clock rollback in Char.setSkillPaint (L5181-5184) / sendUseChargeSkill (L5348-5351) bypass cooldowns?
Does Service.gI().charMove() / Server Controller validate coordinates against tile collisions/speed, given client Char.update() and moveFast / telePortSkill directly mutate cx/cy and emit charMove()?
What type is Mob.hpInjure? Char.updateEffect() (L3049) assigns long expression (cDamFull / 2 - cDamFull * rand / 100) to effPaints[i].eMob.hpInjure.
Are bagSort()/boxSort() item merges (L1548, L1603) synchronized with server inventory state, and how are item.quantity overflows prevented?
How does Service.gI().skill_not_focus(byte) and sendPlayerAttack(vMob, vChar, type) serialize payloads and validate target counts/ranges on server?

findings.impact: High maintenance cost, fragile state transitions, and regressions when modifying movement, skills, or rendering.
findings.root_cause: Char is a massive God class (8754 lines total) combining entity data, inventory sorting, physics/tile collision, waypoint/map transitions, network dispatch, skill state machine, mount animation, and rendering.
findings.title: Monolithic God Class (Char) with tightly coupled physics, network, inventory, and rendering

findings.impact: Bug fixes must be applied twice; dead code paths obscure control flow.
findings.root_cause: Duplicated methods: bagSort() vs boxSort() (L1523-1631), isInEnterOfflinePoint() vs isInEnterOnlinePoint() (L1682-1734), paintMount1() vs paintMount2() (L4698-4937, both containing unreachable `if (me) return;` inside `else`), and empty stubs (updateChargeSkill L1810, saveLoadPreviousSkill L3363, updateSkillFall L3447).
findings.title: Extensive code duplication and dead branches in inventory sorting, waypoints, and mount rendering

findings.impact: Frequent GC spikes and frame drops on mobile/Unity client during combat, charging, and crowded maps.
findings.root_cause: Per-frame heap allocations and string concatenations inside update()/paint(): `new Effect(...)` every 5-10 ticks (L1922, 1927, 1938, 2367), `charID + string.Empty` and `Res.split` (L1951-1969), `Res.outz(... + cName + ...)` every tick during charge (L2168), `strMount + (idMount - ID_NEW_MOUNT) + "_0"` in paintMount1/2 (L4713, 4762, 4831, 4885), `new MyVector()`/`new EffectPaint[]` in setAttack (L5564-5648).
findings.title: Heavy GC allocations and string concatenations in update() and paint() loops

findings.impact: Main-thread stalls / frame hitches during rendering when zoom changes or special mount/mount textures first appear.
findings.root_cause: paintMount1() and paintMount2() invoke checkLoadMount() (synchronously loading 12 PNGs via GameCanvas.loadImage) and getMountData() (reading /Mob/50 from disk via MyStream.readFile) directly during the render pass.
findings.title: Synchronous disk/texture I/O executed inside paintMount1/paintMount2 render path

findings.impact: CPU spikes in crowded maps when multiple players are visible.
findings.root_cause: checkHideCharName() runs every 20 ticks for every remote Char and linearly scans all GameScr.vCharInMap and GameScr.vNpc (O(N^2 + N*M)).
findings.title: Quadratic O(N^2) proximity scan in checkHideCharName() for remote characters

findings.impact: Remote players moving left during auto-jump get cvx=0 instead of jumping horizontally; potential IndexOutOfRangeException if vMovePoints is empty.
findings.root_cause: returnAct() (L3672) and setAutoJump() (L3693) compare signed `num = xEnd - cx` against positive thresholds (`num <= 5`, `num <= 6`) without `abs(num)`, so any leftward movement (`num < 0`) sets `cvx = 0`. updateCharAutoJump() (L3569) also indexes `vMovePoints.firstElement()` without a size check.
findings.title: Missing abs() in returnAct() and setAutoJump() breaks leftward jump velocity

findings.impact: Wrong animation state (ground vs air) for remote players charging skills; wrong Y-axis snapping in updateSkillStand; misaligned ice tile check.
findings.root_cause: 1) update() L2092 checks `TileMap.tileTypeAt(myCharz().cx, myCharz().cy, 2)` instead of `this.cx, this.cy` for all charging characters. 2) updateSkillStand() L3513-3516 calls `TileMap.tileXofPixel(cy + 3)` on a Y coordinate instead of `tileYofPixel`. 3) isFreez L2056 passes tile indices (`cx / TileMap.size, cy / TileMap.size`) to `TileMap.tileTypeAt` which expects pixel coordinates elsewhere.
findings.title: Coordinate and entity-reference bugs in charging, skill stand, and freeze physics

findings.impact: Crash (IndexOutOfRangeException / NullReferenceException / FormatException) on invalid item index, malformed danhHieu data, or maps with >127 waypoints.
findings.root_cause: useItem() accesses `arrItemBag[indexUI]` and `arrItemBody[item.template.type]` without bounds/null checks; danhHieuEff calls `short.Parse` without validation/try-catch; waypoint loops use `sbyte b` up to `TileMap.vGo.size()`.
findings.title: Unchecked array indexing, unguarded parsing, and sbyte loop counter overflow

findings.impact: Client-side cooldown check can be bypassed if system clock moves backward; item stacking lacks overflow caps.
findings.root_cause: setSkillPaint() and sendUseChargeSkill() use wall-clock `mSystem.currentTimeMillis()` and explicitly reset `lastTimeUseThisSkill = num - coolDown` whenever `num < lastTimeUseThisSkill`. bagSort()/boxSort() merge `item2.quantity += item3.quantity` without max cap checks.
findings.title: Client skill cooldown bypass on clock rollback and uncapped client quantity merge

findings.impact: Possible integer overflow/truncation for high-level/high-stat servers if cPower, exp, or currency exceeds Int32.MaxValue.
findings.root_cause: Mixed numeric widths: cPower/cHPFull/cMPFull/cDamFull/xu/xuInBox are `long`, while exp, cMaxEXP, yen, gold_lock, luong, luongKhoa are `int`, and applyCharLevelPercent() casts `(int)(num2 * 10000 / num)`.
findings.title: Inconsistent int vs long types for currencies, EXP, and level percent calculation

key_classes.name: Char
key_classes.responsibility: Core client entity class representing player, remote players, and pets: holds stats, equipment/bag/box arrays, skill list, movement/physics state machine, mounts, effects, and rendering.

module_summary: Read lines 1-5853 of Client/Client/Assets/Scripts/Game1/Char.cs (Unity C# client). Char is a monolithic God class implementing IMapObject that manages character stats, inventory/equipment helpers, task hints, tile-based movement physics, skill casting/charging/cooldowns, mount logic, status effects, and frame rendering. Key issues observed include heavy per-frame GC allocations/string concats and synchronous disk/texture I/O in update()/paint(), duplicated inventory/waypoint/mount methods with dead branches, coordinate/reference bugs in remote player physics/charging, unguarded array/parse operations, and mixed int/long numeric types.
